passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.1
passages.text: Mittit Abydenus, quam mallet ferre, salutem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.2
passages.text: Si cadat unda maris, Sesti puella, tibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.3
passages.text: Si mihi di faciles, si sunt in amore secundi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.4
passages.text: Invitis oculis haec mea verba leges.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.5
passages.text: Sed non sunt faciles; nam cur mea vota morantur

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.6
passages.text: Currere me nota nec patiuntur aqua?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.7
passages.text: Ipsa vides caelum pice nigrius et freta ventis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.8
passages.text: Turbida perque cavas vix adeunda rates.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.9
passages.text: Unus, et hic audax, a quo tibi littera nostra

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.10
passages.text: Redditur, e portu navita movit iter;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.11
passages.text: Adscensurus eram, nisi quod, cum vincula prorae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.12
passages.text: Solveret, in speculis omnis Abydos erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.13
passages.text: Non poteram celare meos, velut ante, parentes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.14
passages.text: Quemque tegi volumus, non latuisset amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.15
passages.text: Protinus haec scribens, 'felix, i, littera!' dixi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.16
passages.text: 'Iam tibi formosam porriget illa manum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.17
passages.text: Forsitan admotis etiam tangere labellis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.18
passages.text: Rumpere dum niveo vincula dente volet.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.19
passages.text: Talibus exiguo dictis mihi murmure verbis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.20
passages.text: Cetera cum charta dextra locuta mea est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.21
passages.text: At quanto mallem, quam scriberet, illa nataret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.22
passages.text: Meque per adsuetas sedula ferret aquas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.23
passages.text: Aptior illa quidem placido dare verbera ponto;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.24
passages.text: Est tamen et sensus apta ministra mei.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.25
passages.text: Septima nox agitur, spatium mihi longius anno,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.26
passages.text: Sollicitum raucis ut mare fervet aquis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.27
passages.text: His ego si vidi mulcentem pectora somnum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.28
passages.text: Noctibus, insani sit mora longa freti!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.29
passages.text: Rupe sedens aliqua specto tua litora tristis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.30
passages.text: Et, quo non possum corpore, mente feror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.31
passages.text: Lumina quin etiam summa vigilantia turre

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.32
passages.text: Aut videt aut acies nostra videre putat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.33
passages.text: Ter mihi deposita est in sicca vestis harena;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.34
passages.text: Ter grave temptavi carpere nudus iter —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.35
passages.text: Obstitit inceptis tumidum iuvenalibus aequor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.36
passages.text: Mersit et adversis ora natantis aquis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.37
passages.text: At tu, de rapidis inmansuetissime ventis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.38
passages.text: Quid mecum certa proelia mente geris?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.39
passages.text: In me, si nescis, Borea, non aequora, saevis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.40
passages.text: Quid faceres, esset ni tibi notus amor?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.41
passages.text: Tam gelidus quod sis, num te tamen, inprobe, quondam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.42
passages.text: Ignibus Actaeis incaluisse negas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.43
passages.text: Gaudia rapturo siquis tibi claudere vellet

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.44
passages.text: Aerios aditus, quo paterere modo?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.45
passages.text: Parce, precor, facilemque move moderatius auram —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.46
passages.text: Imperet Hippotades sic tibi triste nihil!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.47
passages.text: Vana peto; precibusque meis obmurmurat ipse

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.48
passages.text: Quasque quatit, nulla parte coercet aquas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.49
passages.text: Nunc daret audaces utinam mihi Daedalus alas —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.50
passages.text: Icarium quamvis hinc prope litus abest!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.51
passages.text: Quidquid erit, patiar, liceat modo corpus in auras

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.52
passages.text: Tollere, quod dubia saepe pependit aqua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.53
passages.text: Interea, dum cuncta negant ventique fretumque,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.54
passages.text: Mente agito furti tempora prima mei.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.55
passages.text: Nox erat incipiens — namque est meminisse voluptas —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.56
passages.text: Cum foribus patriis egrediebar amans.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.57
passages.text: Nec mora, deposito pariter cum veste timore

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.58
passages.text: Iactabam liquido bracchia lenta mari.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.59
passages.text: Luna fere tremulum praebebat lumen eunti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.60
passages.text: Ut comes in nostras officiosa vias.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.61
passages.text: Hanc ego suspiciens, 'faveas, dea candida,' dixi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.62
passages.text: 'Et subeant animo Latmia saxa tuo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.63
passages.text: Non sinit Endymion te pectoris esse severi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.64
passages.text: Flecte, precor, vultus ad mea furta tuos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.65
passages.text: Tu dea mortalem caelo delapsa petebas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.66
passages.text: Vera loqui liceat! — quam sequor ipsa dea est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.67
passages.text: Neu referam mores caelesti pectore dignos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.68
passages.text: Forma nisi in veras non cadit illa deas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.69
passages.text: A Veneris facie non est prior ulla tuaque;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.70
passages.text: Neve meis credas vocibus, ipsa vide!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.71
passages.text: Quantum, cum fulges radiis argentea puris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.72
passages.text: Concedunt flammis sidera cuncta tuis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.73
passages.text: Tanto formosis formosior omnibus illa est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.74
passages.text: Si dubitas, caecum, Cynthia, lumen habes.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.75
passages.text: Haec ego, vel certe non his diversa, locutus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.76
passages.text: Per mihi cedentes sponte ferebar aquas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.77
passages.text: Unda repercussae radiabat imagine lunae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.78
passages.text: Et nitor in tacita nocte diurnus erat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.79
passages.text: Nullaque vox usquam, nullum veniebat ad aures

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.80
passages.text: Praeter dimotae corpore murmur aquae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.81
passages.text: Alcyones solae, memores Ceycis amati,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.82
passages.text: Nescio quid visae sunt mihi dulce queri.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.83
passages.text: Iamque fatigatis umero sub utroque lacertis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.84
passages.text: Fortiter in summas erigor altus aquas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.85
passages.text: Ut procul aspexi lumen, 'meus ignis in illo est:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.86
passages.text: Illa meum,' dixi, 'litora lumen habent!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.87
passages.text: Et subito lassis vires rediere lacertis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.88
passages.text: Visaque, quam fuerat, mollior unda mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.89
passages.text: Frigora ne possim gelidi sentire profundi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.90
passages.text: Qui calet in cupido pectore, praestat amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.91
passages.text: Quo magis accedo propioraque litora fiunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.92
passages.text: Quoque minus restat, plus libet ire mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.93
passages.text: Cum vero possum cerni quoque, protinus addis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.94
passages.text: Spectatrix animos, ut valeamque facis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.95
passages.text: Nunc etiam nando dominae placuisse laboro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.96
passages.text: Atque oculis iacto bracchia nostra tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.97
passages.text: Te tua vix prohibet nutrix descendere in altum —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.98
passages.text: Hoc quoque enim vidi, nec mihi verba dabam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.99
passages.text: Nec tamen effecit, quamvis retinebat euntem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.100
passages.text: Ne fieret prima pes tuus udus aqua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.101
passages.text: Excipis amplexu feliciaque oscula iungis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.102
passages.text: Oscula, di magni, trans mare digna peti! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.103
passages.text: Eque tuis demptos umeris mihi tradis amictus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.104
passages.text: Et madidam siccas aequoris imbre comam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.105
passages.text: Cetera nox et nos et turris conscia novit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.106
passages.text: Quodque mihi lumen per vada monstrat iter.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.107
passages.text: Non magis illius numerari gaudia noctis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.108
passages.text: Hellespontiaci quam maris alga potest;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.109
passages.text: Quo brevius spatium nobis ad furta dabatur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.110
passages.text: Hoc magis est cautum, ne foret illud iners.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.111
passages.text: Iamque fugatura Tithoni coniuge noctem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.112
passages.text: Praevius Aurorae Lucifer ortus erat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.113
passages.text: Oscula congerimus properata sine ordine raptim

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.114
passages.text: Et querimur parvas noctibus esse moras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.115
passages.text: Atque ita cunctatus monitu nutricis amaro

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.116
passages.text: Frigida deserta litora turre peto.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.117
passages.text: Digredimur flentes, repetoque ego virginis aequor

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.118
passages.text: Respiciens dominam, dum licet, usque meam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.119
passages.text: Siqua fides vero est, veniens hinc esse natator,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.120
passages.text: Cum redeo, videor naufragus esse mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.121
passages.text: Hoc quoque, si credes: ad te via prona videtur;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.122
passages.text: A te cum redeo, clivus inertis aquae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.123
passages.text: Invitus repeto patriam — quis credere possit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.124
passages.text: Invitus certe nunc moror urbe mea.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.125
passages.text: Ei mihi! cur animis iuncti secernimur undis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.126
passages.text: Unaque mens, tellus non habet una duos?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.127
passages.text: Vel tua me Sestos, vel te mea sumat Abydos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.128
passages.text: Tam tua terra mihi, quam tibi nostra placet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.129
passages.text: Cur ego confundor, quotiens confunditur aequor?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.130
passages.text: Cur mihi, causa levis, ventus obesse potest?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.131
passages.text: Iam nostros curvi norunt delphines amores,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.132
passages.text: Ignotum nec me piscibus esse reor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.133
passages.text: Iam patet attritus solitarum limes aquarum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.134
passages.text: Non aliter multa quam via pressa rota.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.135
passages.text: Quod mihi non esset nisi sic iter, ante querebar;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.136
passages.text: At nunc per ventos hoc quoque deesse queror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.137
passages.text: Fluctibus inmodicis Athamantidos aequora canent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.138
passages.text: Vixque manet portu tuta carina suo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.139
passages.text: Hoc mare, cum primum de virgine nomina mersa,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.140
passages.text: Quae tenet, est nanctum, tale fuisse puto.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.141
passages.text: Est satis amissa locus hic infamis ab Helle,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.142
passages.text: Utque mihi parcat, nomine crimen habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.143
passages.text: Invideo Phrixo, quem per freta tristia tutum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.144
passages.text: Aurea lanigero vellere vexit ovis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.145
passages.text: Nec tamen officium pecoris navisve requiro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.146
passages.text: Dummodo, quas findam corpore, dentur aquae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.147
passages.text: Parte egeo nulla; fiat modo copia nandi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.148
passages.text: Idem navigium, navita, vector ero!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.149
passages.text: Nec sequor aut Helicen, aut, qua Tyros utitur, Arcton;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.150
passages.text: Publica non curat sidera noster amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.151
passages.text: Andromedan alius spectet claramque Coronam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.152
passages.text: Quaeque micat gelido Parrhasis Ursa polo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.153
passages.text: At mihi, quod Perseus et cum Iove Liber amarunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.154
passages.text: Indicium dubiae non placet esse viae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.155
passages.text: Est aliud lumen, multo mihi certius istis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.156
passages.text: Non errat tenebris quo duce noster amor;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.157
passages.text: Hoc ego dum spectem, Colchos et in ultima Ponti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.158
passages.text: Quaque viam fecit Thessala pinus, eam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.159
passages.text: Et iuvenem possim superare Palaemona nando

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.160
passages.text: Morsaque quem subito reddidit herba deum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.161
passages.text: Saepe per adsiduos languent mea bracchia motus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.162
passages.text: Vixque per inmensas fessa trahuntur aquas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.163
passages.text: His ego cum dixi: 'pretium non vile laboris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.164
passages.text: Iam dominae vobis colla tenenda dabo,'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.165
passages.text: Protinus illa valent, atque ad sua praemia tendunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.166
passages.text: Ut celer Eleo carcere missus equus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.167
passages.text: Ipse meos igitur servo, quibus uror, amores

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.168
passages.text: Teque, magis caelo digna puella, sequor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.169
passages.text: Digna quidem caelo es — sed adhuc tellure morare,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.170
passages.text: Aut dic, ad superos et mihi qua sit iter!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.171
passages.text: Hic es, et exigue misero contingis amanti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.172
passages.text: Cumque mea fiunt turbida mente freta.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.173
passages.text: Quid mihi, quod lato non separor aequore, prodest?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.174
passages.text: Num minus haec nobis tam brevis obstat aqua?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.175
passages.text: An malim, dubito, toto procul orbe remotus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.176
passages.text: Cum domina longe spem quoque habere meam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.177
passages.text: Quo propius nunc es, flamma propiore calesco,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.178
passages.text: Et res non semper, spes mihi semper adest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.179
passages.text: Paene manu quod amo, tanta est vicinia, tango;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.180
passages.text: Saepe sed, heu, lacrimas hoc mihi 'paene' movet!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.181
passages.text: Velle quid est aliud fugientia prendere poma

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.182
passages.text: Spemque suo refugi fluminis ore sequi?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.183
passages.text: Ergo ego te numquam, nisi cum volet unda, tenebo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.184
passages.text: Et me felicem nulla videbit hiemps,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.185
passages.text: Cumque minus firmum nil sit quam ventus et unda,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.186
passages.text: In ventis et aqua spes mea semper erit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.187
passages.text: Aestus adhuc tamen est. quid, cum mihi laeserit aequor

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.188
passages.text: Plias et Arctophylax Oleniumque pecus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.189
passages.text: Aut ego non novi, quam sim temerarius, aut me

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.190
passages.text: In freta non cautus tum quoque mittet amor;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.191
passages.text: Neve putes id me, quod abest, promittere, tempus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.192
passages.text: Pignora polliciti non tibi tarda dabo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.193
passages.text: Sit tumidum paucis etiamnunc noctibus aequor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.194
passages.text: Ire per invitas experiemur aquas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.195
passages.text: Aut mihi continget felix audacia salvo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.196
passages.text: Aut mors solliciti finis amoris erit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.197
passages.text: Optabo tamen ut partis expellar in illas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.198
passages.text: Et teneant portus naufraga membra tuos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.199
passages.text: Flebis enim tactuque meum dignabere corpus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.200
passages.text: Et 'mortis,' dices, 'huic ego causa fui!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.201
passages.text: Scilicet interitus offenderis omine nostri,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.202
passages.text: Litteraque invisa est hac mea parte tibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.203
passages.text: Desino — parce queri! sed uti mare finiat iram,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.204
passages.text: Accedant, quaeso, fac tua vota meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.205
passages.text: Pace brevi nobis opus est, dum transferor isto;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.206
passages.text: Cum tua contigero litora, perstet hiemps!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.207
passages.text: Istic est aptum nostrae navale carinae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.208
passages.text: Et melius nulla stat mea puppis aqua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.209
passages.text: Illic me claudat Boreas, ubi dulce morari est!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.210
passages.text: Tunc piger ad nandum, tunc ego cautus ero,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.211
passages.text: Nec faciam surdis convicia fluctibus ulla,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.212
passages.text: Triste nataturo nec querar esse fretum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.213
passages.text: Me pariter venti teneant tenerique lacerti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.214
passages.text: Per causas istic inpediarque duas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.215
passages.text: Cum patietur hiemps, remis ego corporis utar;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.216
passages.text: Lumen in adspectu tu modo semper habe!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.217
passages.text: Interea pro me pernoctet epistula tecum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 18.218
passages.text: Quam precor ut minima prosequar ipse mora!
